coordinate_convention.rect: x,y,width,height; pixel edges; no inclusive endpoint
coordinate_convention.pivot: Fixed cell pivot [164,128] for body. Death keeps same cell pivot.

code_reference.pattern_order: Starts normal, then shuffled groups without immediate repeats. shuffle_patterns=False uses barrage -> normal -> homing -> laser.

normal_parry.animation_trigger: single shot at state entry, then idle

homing_parry.animation_trigger: single shot at state entry, then idle

authoring.visual_alignment: Living frames share a fixed pivot and head placement, with a uniform 1.08 source scale. Pencil contours and tentacle shapes retain small hand-drawn variation.
authoring.sockets: Cell-local visual attachment points. muzzle/homing/laser use the left-facing colored contour. Six barrage contour attachment points are sampled at successive height bands. These are visual anchors. Existing code uses the independent world spawn_rules above.
authoring.integration: Art and metadata package. Current code removes the boss immediately on death, so a future integration must keep a visual actor alive to play and hold death.
authoring.parry_colors: Ordinary bullet and missile assets are plum. Reward projectile variants require pink for doodle and sky blue for eraser at integration. They are not supplied as separate variants in this package.
authoring.effects: All effect assets are independent. The laser tile is an isolated beam segment with a transparent margin. Stretching its visible content to the world span and 16px collision thickness is a renderer choice.

generation_prompts.pose: Create a character pose reference image for Python/pico2d game Doodle Wars. Use the user's attached pink squid alien as identity reference: tall oval bulbous pink head, glossy dark eyes, six long soft tentacles, burgundy colored-pencil outlines, dense pink pencil scribble shading. Transparent background PNG. Exactly THREE full-body poses arranged side by side with generous spacing, no text. All face LEFT in a three-quarter view toward an offscreen player. Pose one neutral idle, long hanging curled tentacles. Pose two normal gunfire body pose, one low front tentacle extended horizontally LEFT as an organic firing nozzle, remaining tentacles hanging, alert eyes. Pose three laser charge body pose, tentacles curl inward and brace, concentrated eyes, subtle teal pencil shading INSIDE the pink body. Same head shape, size, anatomy, outline thickness and pink pencil texture across poses. Keep entire characters inside image with transparent margins. No paper, no scenery, no grid, no captions, no weapons, no projectiles, no beam, no external effects. Charming hand-drawn notebook alien, faithful to reference rather than redesign.
generation_prompts.atlas: Production sprite animation atlas, transparent PNG, EXACT 4 COLUMNS by 9 ROWS, 36 individual full-body sprites, equal square cells, no labels/grid. Use previous three-pose image as identity reference. Pink colored-pencil squid alien, tall oval head, burgundy pencil outline, dark glossy eyes, six long pink tentacles. All face LEFT clearly with both eyes looking left. Same head size and head center (55% cell width, 28% cell height), same line thickness and anatomy in every living frame. Character occupies within central 85% of each square cell, transparent padding. 4 sequential frames per row, left to right. Row1 IDLE tentacles gently curl, no whole-body bob. Row2 NORMAL SHOOT low front tentacle aimed straight LEFT, recoil then return. Row3 BARRAGE six tentacle ends fanned and aimed LEFT at different heights, open/recoil/settle, body size constant. Row4 UPPER REST SHOOT one tentacle raised to upper LEFT, relaxed hanging others, no body squash. Row5 HOMING LAUNCH paired left-facing curled tentacles form open launch cradle, recoil/return. Row6 LASER CHARGE inward curled tense tentacles, subtle cyan pencil highlights within pink body, seamless loop. Row7 LASER HOLD tentacles braced aimed LEFT, concentrated eyes, subtle cyan internal highlights, seamless loop. Row8 RECOVERY tense to relaxed neutral over four frames. Row9 DEATH eyes lose focus then shut, head droops, tentacles wilt then collapse intact at bottom of cell, last frame inert pink heap. Separate cell images, no overlaps. NO projectiles, beam, rockets, gun, explosion, glow, particles, captions, shadows, scenery, paper, checkerboard. Preserve colored-pencil grain. Output tall canvas ratio 4:9 with perfectly regular cell placement.
generation_prompts.fx: Create a transparent game effects sprite atlas with EXACT FOUR columns and FIVE rows of equal square cells, 20 effects. Colored-pencil scribble texture and dark burgundy pencil outlines matching the pink squid alien reference. Each effect isolated inside own cell with generous transparent padding. No alien body. Row1 four left-facing small ordinary hostile bullet animation frames, dark plum/purple seed-shaped energy pellets, no pink or cyan parry color. Row2 four left-facing homing missiles, compact hand-drawn purple organic dart rockets with small tail fins and orange propulsion, consistent size. Row3 four horizontal thin cyan laser beam repeating tile frames, cyan pencil outer streak and nearly white inner core, horizontal centered, suitable for stretching horizontally. Row4 four explosion frames, tiny orange spark grows into pink-orange pencil starburst then dissipating short strokes, no smoke background. Row5 four HIT REACTION OVERLAY frames, just sparse small red/burgundy pencil impact stress strokes and short white glints near cell center, transparent everywhere else, NO head, no face, no silhouette, intended to overlay any attack animation without interrupting it. Equal regular cells. No grid lines, text, paper, scenery, shadows, checkerboard. Real transparent alpha PNG.
